                    ### Question
                    Which of the following drugs is used to treat both diabetes mellitus and diabetes insipidus

                    ### Options
                    opa. Chlorpropamide
opb. Glibenclamide
opc. Glicazide
opd. Glipizide

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Chlorpropamide is unique among the options as it treats both diabetes mellitus and diabetes insipidus by increasing insulin secretion and enhancing ADH effect in the kidney. Other drugs like Glibenclamide, Glicazide, and Glipizide only manage diabetes mellitus through insulin secretion and do not affect ADH activity or treat diabetes insipidus.
